method.description: All ordered seat assignments for each seeded deal, sequentially on one host. Same-input validated Normal baselines detect opening opportunities and compare post-opening Hard positions. Baseline calls are excluded from actual-plan latency. Original submitted plans are checked before reducer fallback. No bot strategy is modified. Easy also receives a same-input validated Normal comparison on every personal turn; draw streaks and a count-only Easy trace are recorded.

limitations: Node timing on this CPU is not physical iPhone/iPad performance.
4 distinct deals per format; seat-swapped rounds sharing a deal are correlated.
Time-bounded search may choose different moves under different host load; seeded deals alone do not reproduce scores exactly.
A bot round win is not a measurement of human enjoyment or beginner accessibility.
This sample does not cover four-player games or long multi-round matches.
Draw streaks count consecutive personal turns, interrupted by a play or pass; a round ending can truncate a streak.
A validated Normal play when Easy draws is a witnessed alternative, not proof of optimal play or a defect in Easy's deliberately limited style.
Known opening opportunities and post-opening Hard finishes use one validated Normal baseline, not an exhaustive optimal search or a strength ranking.
